title: VTG Secret Ceremony 1968 Theatre Promo Flyer Elizabeth Taylor Mia Farrow
categoryName: Entertainment Memorabilia:Movie Memorabilia:Merchandise & Promotional:Other Movie Promo Merchandise
descriptionText:
Original vintage promotional flyer for the film Secret Ceremony (1968) starring Elizabeth Taylor and Mia Farrow.
Distributed by The Park Forest Theatre as part of an exclusive Southwestern premiere engagement. Features unique promotional text encouraging viewers to read before seeing the film, along with images and detailed synopsis content.
Condition:
Pre-owned with visible age wear. Light creasing, edge wear, and some discoloration consistent with age. No major tears or missing sections. Please review photos for full condition.
